title: Umme kulsoom kehti thi rokar
body:
Umme kulsoom kehti thi rokar, Ham ko dar dar phiraate hai zaalim
Koi baaqi nahi hai jo sar par, Ham ko dar dar phiraate hai zaalim
Aao abbas e ghaazi kaha ho, Aao haalat behan ki dekho
Jald aao bachaao beradar
<<MINI>>
Ham ko dar dar phiraate hai zaalim
<<DIVIDER>>
Aake bhaabi ko gham se chudhaao, Zaalimo ko ab aakar daraao
Tum kaha ho mere laal akbar
<<MINI>>
Ham ko dar dar phiraate hai zaalim
<<DIVIDER>>
Beqata humko qaidi banakar, Cheen kar farqe at'har se chadar
Bhai ka sar sina par chadha kar
<<MINI>>
Ham ko dar dar phiraate hai zaalim
<<DIVIDER>>
Kabhi bazaar me hum khade hai, Kabhi darbaar me hum khade hai Aur sar par nahi koi chadar
<<MINI>>
Ham ko dar dar phiraate hai zaalim
<<DIVIDER>>
Umme kulsoom ye kah rahi thi, Baandh kar sabke shaanou me rassi
Dil dukha kar sata kar rula kar
<<MINI>>
Ham ko dar dar phiraate hai zaalim
<<DIVIDER>>
Koun tha jo madad karne aata, Puchne wala koi nahi tha
Keh rahi thi hassan sheh ki qwaahar
<<MINI>>
Ham ko dar dar phiraate hai zaalim
